literal_meaning: জটিলা এবং কুটিলা নামক দুটি চরিত্রের নাম
figurative_meaning_bn: কুটবুদ্ধিসম্পন্না, কুঁদুলী, বধূদের দোষ ধরতে নিপুণা; বধুগঞ্জনাকারী কলহপরায়ণা শাশুড়ী-ননদ
figurative_meaning_en: Cunning and quarrelsome, skilled at finding faults in daughters-in-law; tormenting and contentious mother-in-law and sister-in-law
example_sentences_in_bangla: বধূকে সবসময় দোষারোপ করে জটিলা-কুটিলার ভূমিকা পালন করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Her mother-in-law and sister-in-law are as contentious as Jatila-Kuttila.
She plays the role of Jatila-Kuttila by constantly finding faults with the bride.
history: Originates from Vaishnava lore: Jatila and Kuttila are the names of Shri Radha's mother-in-law and sister-in-law in the stories of Krishna and Radha.
note: This idiom draws from devotional tales popular in Bengali culture, often used to describe antagonistic in-law behavior.
